title: Compute a square-strip chromatic polynomial by transfer matrix

source.citation: Jesús Salas and Alan D. Sokal, Transfer Matrices and Partition-Function Zeros for Antiferromagnetic Potts Models I: General Theory and Square-Lattice Chromatic Polynomial, arXiv:cond-mat/0004330

translation.notes: The published width-three free-boundary transfer matrix and vectors are encoded over Z[q]. Computing V T^2 U gives the exact 3-by-3 square-grid chromatic polynomial and its values at two, three and four colors.
